LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Who we are

This website is operated for Sicilia Bella Ristorante, Triq Manoel de Vilhena, Mġarr Harbour, Gozo, Malta. For privacy questions, contact siciliabellamgarr@gmail.com or call +356 2156 3588.

Information we may receive

The website does not currently contain an online account, checkout, contact form or newsletter form. Personal information is mainly received when you choose to contact Sicilia Bella directly by telephone or email, for example to ask a question or request a reservation.

Our hosting provider may also process basic technical information needed to deliver and protect the website, such as IP address, browser information, request time and security logs.

How information is used

  • To respond to enquiries and reservation requests.
  • To operate, secure and maintain the website.
  • To comply with legal or regulatory obligations where required.

Legal basis

Where you contact us, information may be processed to take steps at your request and to manage our legitimate business interests in responding to customers. Information may also be processed where necessary to meet a legal obligation.

Third-party services

The website contains links to third-party services including Google Maps, Google Reviews, Instagram and Facebook. If you follow those links, the third party's own privacy and cookie terms apply. This website does not control how those external services process your information.

Retention

Personal information is kept only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was received, including any legal, accounting or dispute-resolution requirements.

Your rights

Under applicable data-protection law, you may have rights to access, correct, erase or restrict the use of your personal information, object to certain processing, and request data portability where applicable. You may contact us using the email address above. You may also raise a concern with Malta's Office of the Information and Data Protection Commissioner.

Changes to this policy

If the website later adds features such as analytics, online forms, newsletters, online reservations or payment services, this privacy policy will be updated to reflect those changes.

Last updated: 1 October 2026.
